page.overview:
What is Universe 7?

This universe is where the entirety of the Dragon Ball series takes place, except for the Universe 6 Saga in Dragon Ball Super, when Goku and the others go to a neutral area between Universe 7 and Universe 6, the "Future" Trunks Saga taking place between Universe 7 and Universe 10, and the Universe Survival Saga taking place in Zeno's Palace for the Zeno Expo and the Null Realm for the Tournament of Power between eight of the twelve universes. Universe 7 also ranks as the second from the bottom on the mortal level scale as a 3.18 according to Zeno and Future Zeno. In the manga, Universe 7 now ranks as the third from the bottom on the mortal level scale due to their wish for reviving the erased universes.

The God of Destruction of Universe 7 is Beerus, the Supreme Kai is Shin, and the Guide Angel is Whis.

The two quadrants of the universe where the Dragon Ball series is set are the North Area and the South Area; each contains countless galaxies within themselves, In the Universe Survival Saga of Dragon Ball Super, Shin reveals that there are only 28 planets in Universe 7 that have mortal life (though given Shin's lack of knowledge on several important concepts, it's possible that this number is incorrect and there are many more planets which Shin has not noticed). This number was originally higher, when planets such as Sadala, Vegeta, and Namek were still in existence, with the last being replaced by New Namek. Many of the inhabitants of this universe were exterminated by invaders, notably 320 planets with life on them were destroyed by Moro ten million years ago. More recently, the Frieza Force made an industry of committing genocide in order to sell them to be colonized.

While recent material, such as Dragon Ball Super, states that the universe contains countless galaxies, some older material stated that there are only four galaxies.
